description: Reusable authored-pose direction for monk player identities. Identity details always come from player-variants.json and the staged portrait; this profile supplies only class motion and continuity rules.

style.authority: Pixel density, outline language, compact tactical proportions, lighting, and material rendering only. The style image must never override the selected identity portrait or player metadata.

identity.motionStyle: balanced, fluid, controlled, precise, and explosively athletic, with visible guard discipline, hip rotation, and grounded martial-arts footwork
identity.equipmentRule: Keep the authoritative portrait's hand wraps, clothing, belt, jewelry, and any other equipment design and count consistent in every pose. Keep both hands readable, preserve the original handed details, and never invent, duplicate, swap, or transform a staff, blade, shield, or talisman.
identity.magicRule: Monk motion is embodied martial skill rather than spell-casting. Do not add magical projectiles, elemental trails, runes, halos, or aura; if the identity portrait explicitly establishes a subtle ki accent, keep it compact, fixed to that palette, and secondary to anatomy and impact mechanics.

promptTemplates.reference: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: canonical full-body game character reference for a 16-bit fantasy tactical RPG. Image 1 is the authoritative {{displayName}} identity portrait; Image 2 is the approved full-body pixel-art style and proportion reference only. Player identity metadata: {{visualTraits}}. Create one complete head-to-toe {{displayName}} that faithfully preserves Image 1's face, ancestry traits, gender presentation, hair, eyes, complexion, martial clothing, wraps, palette, proportions, and equipment. Do not import identity details from Image 2. {{equipmentRule}} Translate the portrait into the compact full-body quality and agile readable silhouette demonstrated by Image 2. Use a {{background}} background with no floor or scenery. Use a square 1:1 canvas with generous padding on every side. Polished hand-authored 16-bit pixel art with crisp intentional pixel clusters, bold dark outlines, restrained warm top-left highlights, and muted watercolor-and-parchment color ramps. One centered full-body monk in a balanced open-hand guard facing {{baseFacing}}. {{invariants}}
promptTemplates.animation: Draw exactly {{frameCount}} genuinely redrawn full-body {{actionLabel}} poses of the authoritative {{displayName}} in a {{columns}}-column by {{rows}}-row atlas, ordered top row left-to-right and then bottom row left-to-right. Player identity metadata: {{visualTraits}}. Required sequence: {{frameSequence}}. Motion direction: {{motionDirection}}. Overall monk motion is {{motionStyle}}. {{poseRequirement}} Preserve the exact portrait identity, clothing, wraps, palette, proportions, and equipment throughout. {{equipmentRule}} {{magicRule}} Action-specific effects: {{effectRule}} Use a {{background}} background with generous gutters between complete head-to-toe poses. {{invariants}}

idle.motionDirection: A calm diaphragmatic breathing loop with live open-hand guard, softly flexing knees, and alternating centered weight shifts; the first and last poses connect smoothly.
idle.effectRule: No active magic or attack trail; only subtle breathing, cloth, wrap, and hair response.
frameDescriptions: balanced open-hand guard with knees softly bent
slow inhale as spine lengthens and lead hand rises
weight settles onto the forward foot with hips aligned
controlled exhale into a lower defensive guard
centered guard midpoint with both hands active
slow inhale as rear hand chambers and cloth responds
weight settles onto the rear foot with a distinct knee bend
calm open-hand guard flowing back to frame one

walk.motionDirection: A light but grounded alternating-contact walk with elastic knee compression, clear passing poses, opposite guarded arm motion, and quiet controlled landings.
walk.effectRule: No active magic or speed streak; wraps, loose cloth, belt ends, and hair follow the stepping body naturally.
frameDescriptions: left foot light forward contact with hands guarding
left leg elastic compression and lowered center
passing pose with right knee advancing and opposite hand forward
right foot reaching ahead from a balanced single-leg stance
right foot light forward contact with hands still guarding
right leg elastic compression and lowered center
passing pose with left knee advancing and opposite hand forward
left foot reaching ahead into the quiet walking loop

attack.motionDirection: A coherent martial combination moves from guarded anticipation through a stepping palm strike, hip-driven cross, chambered turning kick, full kick extension, balanced landing, and controlled recovery.
attack.effectRule: Only compact physical contact ticks may mark the palm and kick impacts; no weapon, projectile, magical blast, or effect that hides the striking limbs.

rear hand chambers as the lead foot tests forward
stepping lead-palm strike with rear hand protecting the jaw
hip-driven rear cross with shoulders fully rotating

full turning-kick extension with arms counterbalancing
soft bent-knee landing that redirects momentum
controlled recovery into balanced fighting guard

hurt.motionDirection: A sharp body impact breaks the guard into a deep recoil, the monk turns with the force, catches balance in a low stance, redirects momentum through planted hands and feet, then rebuilds the guard.
hurt.effectRule: Use only a compact physical impact accent; no gore, blood, full-body tint, magical ward, or detached equipment.
frameDescriptions: balanced guard before impact
sharp flinch with forearms folding toward the struck side
maximum recoil with torso arched and knees deeply bent
turning stumble that redirects the impact sideways
low three-point balance catch with one hand near the ground
controlled rise with the lead forearm guarding
feet and hips realign beneath a rebuilding guard
recovered balanced fighting guard

death.motionDirection: A decisive impact empties the guard, balance recedes through buckling legs into a low kneel, the torso folds and rolls sideways into ground contact, then settles into an unmistakable fully fallen rest pose.
death.effectRule: No gore, blood, dismemberment, spell effect, or rigid rotation of the upright sprite. Preserve articulated limbs, wraps, clothing, and all identity equipment through the grounded collapse.

arms slacken as weight retreats and balance fails
knees buckle into a low collapsing stance
one knee grounds while the torso folds diagonally
body rolls sideways into full ground contact
low fallen body settles with limbs clearly articulated
final fully fallen monk pose at peaceful rest
same final fallen pose held

victory.motionDirection: The monk recognizes victory, centers with a respectful bow, flows through a crisp palm kata, pivots into a high controlled kick, lands lightly, raises both hands in earned celebration, and holds a poised triumphant finish.
victory.effectRule: No spell effect, projectile, or weapon; body lines, open hands, wraps, and balanced footwork carry the celebration.
